verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud deployment platform, so incremental rollout is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no canary, percentage-based, staged, or blue-green rollout capability. Rollbacks, ephemeral previews, and push-to-deploy are related but different features, so they earn no credit toward limiting blast radius through incremental rollout.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius
